quotations.old_english: Ingá on gesyhþe ðíne geómrunga gecypsedra
quotations.latin: introeat in conspectu tuo gĕmĭtus compĕdītōrum

source_text: ge-cypsed; part, p. Fettered; comp&e-short;d&i-long;tus :-- Ingá on gesyhþe ðíne geómrunga gecypsedra introeat in conspectu tuo g&e-short;m&i-short;tus comp&e-short;d&i-long;t&o-long;rum, Ps. Spl. 78, 11. Driht tolýseþ gecypsede D&o-short;m&i-short;nus solvit comp&e-short;d&i-long;tos, Ps. Spl. 145, 6.
